posts.title: The big expansion is here
posts.text:
There is far more to unlock: 107 tanks, 107 ammo types, 79 home screens and 129 maps. A new premium tier sits above Master pricing, and the Workshop lets you build your own tanks from 129 parts and 24 accent colors.

The most expensive new item is the Terminal Ticket. Buy one and you fight a random boss from a pool of ten, each with its own tank, map and ammo. Beat a boss and it leaves the pool for good.

Two-player and LAN matches also gain map selection and a special attack. The catalog, cheat list and save forge on this site are all updated to match.

posts.title: The TerminalTanks site is open
posts.text:
The site now has a catalog of every tank, ammo type, map and home screen, a full list of cheat codes, and a save forge that builds or edits a save file you can import into the game.

You can still play in the browser from the Play button.
